headline: Bangladesh Gas Fields Company earns Tk148cr pre-tax profit from gas, condensate sales in FY26
summary: The state-owned company produced 4,828.60 million cubic metres of gas from five fields in FY26. It deposited Tk1,048.99 crore into the government exchequer during the year.
why: Bangladesh Gas Fields Company is a state-owned gas producer supplying the country's power and industrial sectors, so its output and payments affect public finances.
